resources.string: Opens Google Wallet when you long press the Back (lower) button instead of Samsung Wallet. Short presses still go back. Nothing is read or collected.
Service is ON.\nLong press Back to open Google Wallet.
Service is OFF.\nTurn on \"Back Button Mapper\" in the watch\'s Accessibility settings (usually under Installed apps).
Google Wallet is not installed on this watch.
Samsung Wallet is disabled: direct mode, no flicker.
Samsung Wallet is enabled: its screen is hidden behind a short black screen. Disable it via adb for direct mode (see README).
Battery: optimized, so the watch may pause the app. Tap below, or use the adb command from the README.
